title: Gini Impurity

plan.insight: A split is good when each side is mostly one class; Gini measures how mixed each side is.
plan.user_changes: split position (drag or slider), add points of a chosen class by clicking, new data
plan.reacts: shaded sides, per-side and weighted Gini bars, weighted Gini number

init:
const pts = range(30).map((i) => { const c = i % 2; return [clamp(randn(c ? 6.5 : 3.5, 1.4), 0.2, 9.8), 0.5 + rand() * 9, c]; });
return { pts };

components.label: New data
components.onClick: return { pts: range(30).map((i) => { const c = i % 2; return [clamp(randn(c ? 6.5 : 3.5, 1.4), 0.2, 9.8), 0.5 + rand() * 9, c]; }) };

components.title: Data and split
components.draw:
return [
  rect(0, 0, state.t, 10, { color: 'blue', opacity: 0.08 }),
  rect(state.t, 0, 10, 10, { color: 'orange', opacity: 0.08 }),
  points(state.pts.map((p) => [p[0], p[1]]), { colors: state.pts.map((p) => p[2] ? 'orange' : 'blue') }),
  vline(state.t, { color: 'gray', dashed: true }),
  point(state.t, 9.6, { id: 'split', draggable: true, color: 'gray' })
];

components.title: Gini

components.label: Weighted Gini
